issue.title: [bug] Stale CFR snippet (3 days old) injected into social-mode prompt — technical question answered with tools suppressed
issue.symptom: 2026-07-18 17:40 'Good morning' turn (packet e996eb04): conversation_cfr surfaced the 3-day-old unanswered container question as relevant_history_snippet, while intent=greeting triggered social mode: tool calls suppressed, capability + system-health blocks skipped, world-state trimmed. Model addressed the injected technical question in helpless-chitchat mode: 'I don't have that information memorized. Can you tell me what type of containers are used for GAIA?' Two coupled defects: (a) CFR relevance x decay admitted a 72h-old snippet on an unrelated greeting — decay too weak or dangling-question bonus too strong; (b) prompt mode is chosen solely by CURRENT-message intent while injected snippets can carry a technical task — social lean mode + system-keyword-bearing snippets is an incoherent prompt state (the 'two gates' principle violated: gate 1 admitted content that gate 2's mode cannot serve). Fix: age-aware decay floor in conversation_cfr; and when current msg OR admitted snippets contain system keywords, do not suppress tools / use standard prompt (must NOT regress 7n3 — pure greetings stay lean).

regression_test.format: pytest functions added by the fix
regression_test.gold:
# candidates/gaia-core/gaia_core/memory/tests/test_conversation_cfr.py
"""
Tests for 231 Phase 3: CFR deixis/stickiness for meta-reference follow-ups.

A short deictic question ("what's its name?", "the second one", "that link")
refers back to recent content but embeds poorly against that content's body, so
plain cosine relevance would blur the very turn the user is asking about. The
detector widens the recency anchor + relaxes the floor so recent turns survive.
"""
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone

import pytest

from gaia_core.memory.conversation_cfr import looks_like_reference_query, select_focus_turns


@pytest.mark.parametrize("msg", [
    "Can you tell me its name?",
    "What's the second one?",
    "that link please",
    "You just said something interesting",
    "what was that?",
    "which one is better",
])


def _iso(dt):
    return dt.isoformat()


def test_stale_dangling_question_not_anchored_into_greeting():
    """tr7f: a 3-day-old unanswered technical question, sitting as the very
    last turn before a much-later greeting, must NOT ride in via the
    anchor (which previously force-kept the trailing turn unconditionally)."""
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    old_ts = _iso(now - timedelta(hours=72))
    history = [
        {"id": "m1", "role": "user",
         "content": "What kind of docker containers does GAIA run in?",
         "timestamp": old_ts},
    ]
    focus, dbg = select_focus_turns(history, "Good morning GAIA", max_focus=6, anchor_n=1)
    assert dbg.get("anchor", 0) == 0
    assert not any(t["id"] == "m1" for t in focus)


def test_fresh_last_turn_still_anchored():
    """The same shape, but the prior turn is seconds old — normal live
    continuity must be unaffected by the staleness gate."""
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    fresh_ts = _iso(now - timedelta(seconds=5))
    history = [
        {"id": "m1", "role": "user", "content": "What kind of docker containers does GAIA run in?",
         "timestamp": fresh_ts},
    ]
    focus, dbg = select_focus_turns(history, "Good morning GAIA", max_focus=6, anchor_n=1)
    assert dbg.get("anchor", 0) == 1
    assert any(t["id"] == "m1" for t in focus)


def test_stale_but_topically_relevant_turn_still_excluded_by_scoring():
    """Defense-in-depth for the scored (non-anchor) path: even when a stale
    turn IS genuinely on-topic with the current message (so raw cosine
    relevance alone would admit it), real elapsed time must still gate
    eligibility — a 3-day-old technical turn several positions back in an
    otherwise-unrelated conversation shouldn't outlive its wall-clock
    relevance just because turn-distance decay is weak."""
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    old_ts = _iso(now - timedelta(hours=72))
    fresh_ts = _iso(now - timedelta(seconds=10))
    history = [
        {"id": "old", "role": "user",
         "content": "What kind of docker containers does GAIA run in?",
         "timestamp": old_ts},
        {"id": "a1", "role": "assistant", "content": "Let's talk later.", "timestamp": old_ts},
        {"id": "u1", "role": "user", "content": "Sounds good, see you then.", "timestamp": fresh_ts},
        {"id": "a2", "role": "assistant", "content": "See you!", "timestamp": fresh_ts},
    ]
    focus, dbg = select_focus_turns(
        history, "which containers am I running again?", max_focus=6, anchor_n=1)
    assert not any(t["id"] == "old" for t in focus)

# candidates/gaia-core/tests/test_prompt_builder_tr7f.py
"""Regression test for GAIA_Project-tr7f: prompt mode was chosen solely by
the CURRENT message's intent, so a CFR-admitted history snippet carrying a
stale technical question could ride into a greeting-intent turn while the
prompt dropped into lean social mode (tools suppressed, capability block
skipped) — an incoherent combination (a system-keyword-bearing snippet with
nothing able to act on it). Pins: an admitted snippet with a system/infra
keyword keeps the standard (non-lean) prompt even on a chitchat-classified
turn; a snippet with no such content still gets the lean social mode
(no regression on the pure-greeting case, GAIA_Project-7n3).
"""
from gaia_common.protocols.cognition_packet import (
    CognitionPacket, Content, Context, Intent, RelevantHistorySnippet,
)
from gaia_core.utils import prompt_builder


def _joined(messages):
    return " ".join(str(m.get("content", "")) for m in messages)


def _packet(user_text: str, snippet_summary: str = None):
    snippets = []
    if snippet_summary is not None:
        snippets = [RelevantHistorySnippet(id="m1", role="user", summary=snippet_summary)]
    return CognitionPacket(
        content=Content(original_prompt=user_text),
        intent=Intent(user_intent="greeting"),
        context=Context(relevant_history_snippet=snippets),
    )


def test_greeting_with_stale_technical_snippet_stays_standard_mode():
    packet = _packet("Good morning GAIA", snippet_summary="What kind of docker containers does GAIA run in?")
    messages = prompt_builder.build_from_packet(packet)
    joined = _joined(messages)
    assert "— Capabilities (you have these; use them) —" in joined
    assert "This is casual conversation" not in joined


def test_pure_greeting_still_gets_lean_social_mode():
    packet = _packet("Good morning GAIA", snippet_summary="Good morning to you too!")
    messages = prompt_builder.build_from_packet(packet)
    joined = _joined(messages)
    assert "This is casual conversation" in joined
    assert "— Capabilities (you have these; use them) —" not in joined
